# Web-app buildout rules (plugin) — run ONCE during repo creation, then discarded.
# One-time structural checks on the project split and that CI validates the
# production build; the ongoing web-app judgment (server boundary, authz, URL
# state, browser journeys against the built app) lives in
# shapes/web-app.llmlint.yml.
version: 1.1

rules:
  - name: production_build_validated_in_ci
    description: |
      true when CI builds the PRODUCTION bundle (not just starts the dev server) and
      treats type and lint errors as build blockers. false when CI only runs the dev
      server or tests, so a production build could be broken and merge anyway.
    files:
      include: ["justfile", "Justfile", ".justfile", ".github/workflows/**"]

  - name: app_browser_suite_and_services_split
    description: |
      true when the app and its fast unit/component tests are one project, the
      browser suite is its own project whose `test` target depends on the app's
      `build`, and each backend service the app calls is its own project rather
      than a directory inside the app. false when the browser suite lives in the
      app project — so any change can start a browser — or when a backend service
      is a folder of the app project, so a server-only change rebuilds the frontend
      and vice versa.
    files:
      include: ["nx.json", "**/project.json", "**/e2e/**", "**/playwright.config.*"]
